title: Generate a playable environment or procedural level
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for generate a playable environment or procedural level.

ordered_stages.action: Define bounds, traversal metrics, landmarks, spawn rules, and performance budgets.
Generate candidate layout data separately from art dressing.
Validate connectivity, collision, navigation, reachability, and encounter constraints.
Add lighting and assets while preserving gameplay readability.
Exercise spawn-to-goal routes and capture frame-time and visual evidence.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
All required spawns and objectives are reachable.
Navigation, lighting, collision, streaming, and runtime budgets pass.

fallbacks: Use a deterministic procedural layout seed.
Reduce dressing density before changing navigation-critical geometry.
